2084. Comparing Integer and Float Division

40

Medium

Problem Statement
Read two integers and print the result of dividing them once as integer division and once as float division.
Description
Read two integers a and b. Compute their quotient using integer division (a / b) and print it. Then compute their quotient using float division by casting one operand to float, and print that result with two decimal places.
input_spec: Two integers a and b, separated by a space.
output_spec: Print the integer quotient, then the float quotient (2 decimal places).
